resource_risks.description: Scanning full accumulated terminal output on every poll can grow CPU cost with long sessions.
resource_risks.mitigation: Decision detection scans only recent stdout/stderr tails bounded by MAX_DECISION_SCAN_BYTES.

resource_risks.description: A slow poll could overlap with the next interval tick and stack Tauri calls.
resource_risks.mitigation: activeSessionPollInFlightRef skips a poll while the previous one is in flight.

resource_risks.description: Refreshing the decision inbox on every poll can create avoidable Tauri/file reads.
resource_risks.mitigation: Inbox refreshes are throttled with INBOX_REFRESH_THROTTLE_MS.

measurement_checks.threshold: largest initial chunk below configured budget

notes: No new process, worker, or dependency was added.
